LEDGER / LOCAL STARTUP

Bring up the reports workspace

Ledger is a fictional reporting app used as a reader fixture. This guide starts its API and its review frontend on your machine, or a fully offline preview when you only need to look at the screens.

Fixture · nothing here is real
1 · Choose a modeOffline preview, or the API plus the frontend.
2 · Check prerequisitesPython 3.12, Node 20 and a local database file.
3 · Start the API firstThen build and serve the frontend.
4 · Open the reviewReports, a single report, or the offline preview.
The connected mode writes to your local database. Use a scratch database file. The offline preview writes nothing and needs no keys.

Two terminals for the connected workspace

Start the API in the first terminal and leave it running. Then build and serve the frontend in the second. Both bind to 127.0.0.1 only.

Terminal A · API server

Keep it in the foreground. Expect “Ledger API listening on 127.0.0.1:8011”. Stop it with Ctrl+C.

Terminal B · Frontend review host

The build bakes the port into the page, so build and serve must use the same LEDGER_PORT.

The review host forwards /api/* to LEDGER_API_URL. Change LEDGER_PORT and --port together if 4320 or 8011 is taken.

Open these routes

Reports · A sample report · Settings

A report link uses /reports/<id>. Settings shows which API the page is talking to.

A fully offline preview

No API, database or key is needed. This renders the screens from bundled sample data; buttons that would save are disabled.

One terminal · Offline preview

Open the quarterly sample. Add &dark=1 for dark mode.

Configuration and prerequisites

WhereWhat must be configured
API api/.envLEDGER_DB picks the database file; it defaults to ./scratch.db. LEDGER_LOG_LEVEL is optional.
FrontendLEDGER_PORT and LEDGER_API_URL, set on the command line as above.
RuntimePython 3.12 or later and Node 20 or later. Dependencies install from the public package registries.
Sample datapython -m ledger.seed fills a scratch database with three example reports.
Only if dependencies are missing

Install once per checkout. Both commands only touch the project folder.

Concrete fixes

Frontend says the API is unreachable

Check Terminal A is still running and that LEDGER_API_URL matches its port. Rebuild if you changed LEDGER_PORT.

Port already in use

Pick another port for both build and serve. The check below lists what is listening.

Port and health check

What was verified

This is a fixture, so nothing was launched. Its job is to exercise the reader: a dark header, two side-by-side terminals that must show every line without scrolling, copy buttons, a wide table that has to reflow at phone width, a collapsed details section and enough length that the last heading sits below the fold.

  • At 1440 and 390 CSS pixels the document never scrolls sideways.
  • Every terminal sizes itself to its content on load and on resize.
  • Copy buttons fall back to selecting the text when the clipboard is unavailable.
